nodes.description: Public owner address used by the onlyOwner modifier to gate privileged functions.
Hard-coded privileged marketing address that can bypass the onlyOwner restriction.
Mapping of token balances, mutated in _transfer, burn and the constructor.
Nested mapping of spending allowances written by _approve.
Blacklist mapping checked inside _transfer to block flagged addresses.
Secondary blacklist mapping whose non-false entry blocks transfers.
Total supply, assigned in constructor and increased inside burn.
Boolean guarding one-time execution of openTrading.
Uniswap V2 router instance stored during openTrading and reused for liquidity calls.
LP pair address created in openTrading and later copied into router.
Block number recorded at trading open, used in _transfer to hide early transfers.
Flag consumed by the router transfer restriction check inside _transfer.
Internal router address compared with recipient in _transfer; set by setReflections.
Per-address exemption mapping consulted in the _transfer router check.
Contract constructor that mints the whole supply to msg.sender and sets owner.
onlyOwner function that transfers contract ownership to an arbitrary address.
onlyOwner function that burns ownership by moving it to the dead address.
onlyOwner function that flags arbitrary addresses in the bots mapping.
onlyOwner function that clears the bots flag for arbitrary addresses.
onlyOwner function that overwrites router with uniswapV2Pair and disables balances1.
onlyOwner function that creates the Uniswap pair, adds liquidity and flips tradingOpen.
Payable receiver that lets the contract hold ETH for liquidity provision.
ERC20 transfer entry point that forwards to _transfer using _msgSender().
ERC20 transferFrom entry point that moves tokens and decrements allowance.
ERC20 approve entry point that writes allowances through _approve.
View function returning the stored balance of an account.
Internal transfer core containing blacklist checks, router restriction and unchecked balance writes.
onlyOwner function misleadingly named burn that actually mints new supply to an account.
Internal allowance writer used by approve, transferFrom and openTrading.
Empty hook called before balance mutations in _transfer and burn.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowances and transfer routing.
Miner-influenced timestamp passed as the deadline of the Uniswap liquidity call.
Modifier require((owner == msg.sender) || (msg.sender == marketAddy)) granting privileged access to two roles.
Unconditional set of owner to 0x...dEaD, permanently removing administrative control.
unchecked block computing _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount in _transfer.
Arithmetic that increases _totalSupply and _balances[account], i.e. arbitrary minting by the owner.
Loop writing the bots mapping for every element of an owner-supplied address array.
addLiquidityETH external call consuming the full contract balance with block.timestamp as deadline.
Assignment router = uniswapV2Pair plus balances1 = false, which rewrites the sell restriction.
New owner address accepted by changeOwner.
Address array supplied to giveReflections and written into the bots mapping.
Address array supplied to toggleReflections and cleared from the bots mapping.
Source address parameter of _transfer.
Destination address parameter of _transfer, compared against router.
Token amount parameter of _transfer.
Beneficiary address parameter of burn.
Amount parameter of burn, added to both _totalSupply and the account balance.
Local copy of _balances[sender] used in the unchecked subtraction.
Local allowance snapshot read in transferFrom before being decremented.
Local router instance created and used inside openTrading.

edges.reason: msg.sender decides whether the onlyOwner require passes, gating all privileged functions.
changeOwner can only execute when msg.sender equals owner or marketAddy.
RenounceOwnership is reachable only for msg.sender satisfying the owner requirement.
The constructor uses msg.sender as both supply recipient and initial owner.
block.timestamp is supplied as the deadline of the addLiquidityETH call, making it miner dependent.
onlyOwner modifier guards changeOwner.
onlyOwner modifier guards RenounceOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier guards giveReflections.
onlyOwner modifier guards toggleReflections.
onlyOwner modifier guards setReflections.
onlyOwner modifier guards openTrading.
onlyOwner modifier guards the burn/mint function.
The owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner check.
marketAddy is read by the onlyOwner check, granting a permanent second privileged role.
owner is overwritten with the dead address in RenounceOwnership.
_totalSupply is read and assigned during construction.
_balances[msg.sender] is credited with the full supply in the constructor.
setReflections copies uniswapV2Pair into router, changing how sells are classified in _transfer.
router is compared with recipient in _transfer, deciding whether the sell restriction applies.
balances1 participates in the router transfer restriction check.
openBlock gates the early-transfer branch that emits a zero-value Transfer event.
_blackbalances[sender] must be false for a transfer to proceed.
bots[sender] and bots[recipient] are checked to block blacklisted accounts.
_balances1[sender] can bypass the router transfer restriction.
_totalSupply is incremented by the owner-controlled burn/mint operation.
_balances[sender] is written inside the unchecked subtraction.
The burn/mint operation credits _balances[account] without any supply cap.
openTrading triggers the external addLiquidityETH call.
openTrading stores the created router instance in uniswapV2Router.
openTrading assigns the newly created pair to uniswapV2Pair.
giveReflections drives the loop that flags arbitrary addresses in bots.
toggleReflections drives the loop that clears arbitrary addresses in bots.
setReflections performs the router override and disables balances1.
_transfer invokes the empty _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_transfer enters the unchecked balance subtraction block.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom decrements the allowance through _approve.
approve writes the allowance through _approve.
burn executes the supply and balance increments of burn_mint.
ETH received through receive() funds the addLiquidityETH value in openTrading.
The _owner parameter is written into the owner state variable.
recipients_ is iterated inside giveReflections.
Each element of recipients_ is written into the bots blacklist mapping.
recipients2_ is iterated inside toggleReflections.
Each element of recipients2_ clears the bots blacklist flag.
The sender parameter flows into the checks of _transfer.
sender indexes the balance mapping used in the unchecked subtraction.
The recipient parameter is compared with router and credited in _transfer.
The amount parameter bounds-checked and moved in _transfer.
amount is the subtrahend of the unchecked balance subtraction.
The account parameter is the beneficiary of the burn/mint function.
burnAmount is added to both the total supply and the account balance.
senderBalance is the cached value used inside the unchecked subtraction.
currentAllowance is validated and reduced in transferFrom.
_uniswapV2Router is the local router handle created in openTrading.
_uniswapV2Router is the target of the external addLiquidityETH call.
